caseName: Algonquin Gas Transmission Co. v. Northeastern Gas Transmission Co.
caseNameFull: Algonquin Gas Transmission Co. v. Northeastern Gas Transmission Co.

opinions.text:
The motion to withhold the order denying certiorari, ante, p. 818, pending the filing and disposition of a petition for rehearing is denied.

The Chief Justice took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion.
